div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
1. Calculate Total Validated Worked Minutes
(Subtract N65 Inter-Session Gaps)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Fetch Shift Policy & OT Parameters
(Daily Threshold, Grace Period, Min OT Threshold)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Worked Minutes >
Scheduled Shift Minutes
+ Daily Grace Period?

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Daily OT = 0.0 Hours
Regular Attendance Normal Rollup

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Calculate Raw Excess Minutes:
Excess = Worked - Scheduled Shift

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Excess Minutes >=
Min OT Threshold?
(e.g. >= 30 mins)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Flag as INCIDENTAL_STAY
Daily OT = 0.0 Hours (No Pay)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Apply OT Rounding Rule
(15-min / 30-min block floor)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Was Pre-Approved OT
Registered for Date D?
(Pre-Shift Overtime Form)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Match with Pre-Approved Cap:
Daily OT = min(Raw OT, Pre-Approved Cap)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: Set Status: PRE_APPROVED_PENDING_VERIFY

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Tenant Requires
Pre-Approval Only?

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Mark: UNAUTHORIZED_EXTRA_TIME
Daily OT = 0.0 Hours (Excluded from Pay)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Submit Post-Facto OT Request
Workflow: M18 Approval Engine

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Supervisor / Manager
Decision (BR-OTC-01)?

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Mark: UNAUTHORIZED_EXTRA_TIME
Persist Audit Reason in Trace

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
2. Weekly Overtime Engine Accumulator
Aggregate Mon-Sun Worked Hours in Pay Group

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Total Cumulative
Weekly Hours > 48h?
(Factories Act §51)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Add Difference to Weekly Statutory OT Accumulator
Statutory Rate Band Triggered

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: Record as Standard Daily Overtime

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Total Weekly Hours > 60h
OR Quarterly OT > Limit?
(Factories Act §54/64)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Flag STATUTORY_OT_BREACH_WARNING
Notify HR & Factory Compliance Officer

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

3. Determine Allocation Destination
(Employee Preference / Tenant Policy)

span.p:
Route to Payroll Engine (M12)
Pending Pay Run Ingestion (Step 4)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Fetch Pay Group Overtime Multiplier:
- Standard Days: 1.5x / 2.0x
- Rest Day / Holiday: 2.0x (Double Rate)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Calculate OT Monetary Amount:
OT_Amount = OT_Hours * Hourly_Wage * Multiplier

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Ingest into Pay Run Step 4 (N20 Authorized)
Write to pay_run_employee_snapshots

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Route to Leave Engine (M11)
Double-Entry Ledger Ingestion

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Convert OT Hours to Comp-Off Days:
(e.g., 8 Hours OT = 1.0 Comp-Off Day,
4 Hours OT = 0.5 Comp-Off Day)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Insert Immutable Row in leave_transactions:
transaction_type = ACCRUAL
leave_type = COMP_OFF
valid_until = Date_D + 60 Days

Arm Celery Expiry Task at T+60 Days
Auto-lapse unused balance if unredeemed
